A distributed botnet could be used to send a massive number of requests to the API endpoints, potentially exhausting resources or causing throttling.

Insecure Data Transmission [Information Disclosure, CWE-319] on APIGateway, CloudFront, Lambda, S3, ElastiCache: Without proper encryption in transit, data moving between components could be intercepted by attackers who have gained access to the network. Event Injection Through EventBridge [Tampering, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-74] on EventBridge, Lambda, ForecastGenerator: If event patterns and validation are not properly configured, attackers could potentially inject malicious events that trigger Lambda functions or other targets. An attacker could potentially inject malicious data into the Kinesis stream or manipulate the analytics application code to produce incorrect analysis results.
